Name: Flowery Bin
Author: AndrAla
Description:
[center][size=3]A dark wood bin to match [b][i]Kaya's Flower Valley[/i][/b], and [i]Gweniaczek's Medieval Buildings[/i]. Plus hopefully,[b][i] Eemie's Darker wood and gold craftables[/i][/b], also Eemie's [i][b]Medieval Modern Buildings[/b][/i]. 
As my first attempt at Modding, thank you for downloading and being patient with my errors.
 
[color=#616161]~~~~~~[b]Notes[/b]~~~~~~
Working on a flowery vine lid.[/color]
~~~~~~~~~[b]Instructions[/b]~~~~~~~~~~
Have both updated version of SMAPI, and Content Patcher!
[code][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/code]﻿
[code][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url][/code]
Simply download the .zip file.
Unzip and place it into your mods folder.
Once the config. file is created, (when the game is run)
you can change the options of having vines with flowers to having just a plain bin. 
Colors are DarkWood, DarkWire (Darkwood with Wired Lid), Birch, A Joja bin, Wooden Cart-like with
a smol bin in either Dark Wood & Vanilla bins, A stone cart(kinda cart like) with also Smol Darkwood & Vanilla bins,
Then the last two are A plain wooden cart with "no bin", and a stone plain cart with "no bin".
Flowery versions for all is included.
There is an option in main files for just Darkwood, Birch, Joja.
Enjoy your new bin !
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
~~~~~~~~~[b]Uninstall Mod[/b]~~~~~~~~
Simply delete mod from your mods folder
